decision.rationale: TXN-008088 was posted on 2026-07-31 to card CRD-000177. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-31, 92 days later, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant, MER-000047 (Oakhollow Bistro), is a RESTAURANT. Its authorisation AUTH-008279 was approved for 11956 cents (119.56 EUR), and the posted amount is 13868 cents (138.68 EUR). There is no receipt in the case. The 119.56 EUR bill is only the cardholder's claim, and it matches the authorised amount. The posted amount is 1912 cents (19.12 EUR) above the authorised amount. The tip allowance is 20% of 11956, which is 2391.2 cents (23.91 EUR). The difference is within that allowance, so under amount-restaurant-tip it counts as an agreed tip, not an amount mismatch, and the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The restaurant was approved for 119.56 EUR and posted 138.68 EUR. The 19.12 EUR difference is within the 20% that a restaurant may add as a tip on top of the approved amount, so it is treated as an agreed tip, not a wrong amount.
